findings.summary: Empty form controls have low-contrast boundaries in both light and dark themes.
findings.fix: Increase border-field-default to at least 3:1 against field and surrounding page surfaces in both themes; retain separate inactive styling. Apply to controls whose empty editable extent is identified by their border.
findings.evidence: On /admin/users/new/ username, first/last name and password fields: light border #c8c8c8 against white field/content =1.67:1; dark border #5c5c5c against #262626 field/content =2.26:1. Empty fields have no contrasting fill or other extent indicator.

findings.summary: The disabled-row style also dims ordinary table metadata to 1.65:1 contrast.
findings.fix: Restrict opacity changes to genuinely inactive controls; keep informational table cell text at 4.5:1. Review disabled chooser/listing rows so unavailable choices do not make their identifying metadata unreadable.
findings.evidence: /admin/styleguide/: .disabled > td:nth-child(2) and td:nth-child(3) contain static "Standard TD", not inactive controls. opacity:.25 yields #c9c9c9 on white (axe1.65:1,12.92px). Inactive choice title is not used as the basis of this finding.

findings.summary: The editor header requires horizontal scrolling to reach the Live-page control at 320 CSS pixels.
findings.fix: Allow the header status/action strip to wrap or move secondary actions into an accessible disclosure at narrow widths, so all controls fit within320px without horizontal scrolling.
findings.evidence: Settled desktop-to320px resize on /admin/pages/69/edit/: status/action strip clientWidth320,scrollWidth368; Live-page link x306,right360.45. Its text and right edge are outside the viewport until the strip scrolls; document also requires vertical scrolling.

passed: All100 sampled pages underwent light-theme axe contrast checks; only styleguide disabled-row text was flagged.
Dark-theme color-contrast axe checks pass on users/new, pages69edit, site-history and account after removing light-theme class and allowing transitions to settle.
Measured first25 Tab focus outlines throughout100 pages use visible3px green outlines; green #00a885 on white is3.03:1. Separate focal-point offscreen focus defect is owned by keyboard-navigator.
Rechecked chooser text-spacing candidates using glyph Range bounds: labels remained inside controls; apparent scrollHeight clipping did not remove text.
Representative200% text-size checks used doubled precomputed font sizes on user creation, form-page editor, site-history and account; no verified content loss.
Settled320px tests reproduce document/body widths320 on suspect site-history, history and form-editor pages; excess table width stays inside table scrollers and was not counted as reflow failure.
Dashboard expanded-dropdown target-size flags concern date rectangles partly covered by popup; visible portion still has24px-circle spacing, so no confirmed2.5.8 failure was recorded.
notes: Source includes forced-colors and increased-contrast adaptations, plus reduced-motion safeguards for selected components; interactive animations were not exhaustively measured and lack of a global reduction rule alone is not an AA failure.
The editor toolbar reflow finding concerns non-table controls; data-table horizontal scrolling is an allowed two-dimensional-layout exception.
Automatic text-spacing and overflow candidates were manually triaged using DOM geometry without screenshots.
